facts.note: Transcript gives the same kitchen clock reading (quarter past ten when the temple struck ten) and the same claim that the clock is kept fast on purpose.
Lina came down at twenty-three minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
Piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed three minutes past eleven.

added.quote: I went up to fetch the master for the toast.
added.why: Rosa left the kitchen and went up toward the atelier at some unstated moment, so she is placed somewhere other than the kitchen. The sheet does not mention this movement. Its timing is not given, though, so it fixes no time.
